claim: A NAT gateway supports NAT64, translation from IPv6 to IPv4, so IPv6 resources can communicate with IPv4 resources in the same or another VPC, on premises or over the internet; NAT64 works with DNS64 on the Amazon resolver or with your own DNS64 server.
question: How can IPv6-only resources reach IPv4-only services?

values.display: A NAT gateway supports network address translation from IPv6 to IPv4, popularly known as NAT64

evidence.quote: A NAT gateway supports network address translation from IPv6 to IPv4, popularly known as NAT64. NAT64 helps your IPv6 AWS resources communicate with IPv4 resources in the same VPC or a different VPC, in your on-premises network or over the internet. You can use NAT64 with DNS64 on Amazon Route 53 Resolver or use your own DNS64 server.
